CREATE TABLE we48schema.stg_retail_txns
(
    txnid INT,
    txndate VARCHAR(20),
    custid INT,
    amt FLOAT,
    category VARCHAR(100),
    product VARCHAR(200),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    state VARCHAR(100),
    payment_mode VARCHAR(20)
) WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION=ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
)
;


CREATE TABLE we48schema.retail_txns
(
    txnid INT,
    txndate DATE,
    custid INT,
    amt FLOAT,
    category VARCHAR(100),
    product VARCHAR(200),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    state VARCHAR(100),
    payment_mode VARCHAR(20)
) WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION=HASH(city),
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
)
;


Alter  PROCEDURE we48schema.sp_etl_txns
    @processType VARCHAR(50)

AS
BEGIN

DECLARE @rowcount int;

select @rowcount=count(*) from we48schema.stg_retail_txns

if @rowcount=0
BEGIN
PRINT 'no record in the staging table '
End
ELSE
BEGIN
PRINT 'loading '+cast(@rowcount as varchar(10))+' data into main table '

if @processType='INSERT'
BEGIN

INSERT INTO we48schema.retail_txns
select 
    txnid,
    Try_CONVERT(DATE,txndate,110), -- MM-DD-YYYY
    custid,
    amt,category,
    product,city,state,payment_mode
from we48schema.stg_retail_txns;

TRUNCATE TABLE we48schema.stg_retail_txns;

PRINT 'Insert completed ... ' + cast(@rowcount as varchar(10));

END
ELSE
begin

DELETE from we48schema.retail_txns;

INSERT INTO we48schema.retail_txns
select 
    txnid,
    Try_CONVERT(DATE,txndate,110), -- MM-DD-YYYY
    custid,
    amt,category,
    product,city,state,payment_mode
from we48schema.stg_retail_txns;

TRUNCATE TABLE we48schema.stg_retail_txns;

PRINT 'Reload completed ....'
end 

End



end







exec  we48schema.sp_etl_txns  @processType ='INSERT'
